title: ICS findings reporting (active assessment, no write/control)
description: How to report OT/ICS issues; active testing done, but no control actions taken.
detail: 1) State scope and method: **active network assessment** performed (enumeration/fingerprinting/read-only queries) — **no write/control/actuation performed**. 2) List assets/ports/protocols (incl. DNP3, Siemens S7, Schneider Modicon/UMAS, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, BACnet, IEC-104, OPC UA, etc.) and exact evidence. 3) Describe exposure and realistic impact (safety/availability/integrity) factually; do not include steps that perform control/write/actuation. 4) Recommend segmentation, allowlisting, auth where supported, patching, monitoring. 5) Mark confidence/validation; link evidence IDs.
